g.text: Access-kit erection sequence and unexecuted hold points
Planning illustration only; no construction or proof test has been performed.
1. survey · assumed 0 days
site/utility/ground/level survey
HOLD: approved survey and ground records
2. detail · assumed 0 days
connections, structural/access/fire details
HOLD: reviewed calculations and drawings
3. factory · assumed 10 days
fabrication / casting and dimensional QA
HOLD: material trace, coupons, dimensional inspection
4. strength · assumed 28 days
concrete reference strength development or weld NDT
HOLD: measured strength or qualified weld inspection
5. supports · assumed 28 days
independent support and foundation installations
HOLD: ground design, setting-out, connection QA
6. deliver · assumed 9 days
bounded delivery at six full spans/day
HOLD: route, axle loads, lift points and transport survey
7. erect · assumed 14 days
crane placement at four full spans/day
HOLD: crane-at-radius, wind and ground bearing checks
8. connect · assumed 14 days
bearings, joints, parapets, shade and access cores
HOLD: temporary stability and complete locked connections
9. accept · assumed 3 days
survey, access, proof and functional tests
HOLD: independent acceptance; all measurements unexecuted
